conclusion.statement: The executive summary states that Form 2553 was filed on March 22, 2022 for an election effective January 1, 2019. The late-election procedure excerpt requires a completed Form 2553 signed by an authorized officer and all persons who were shareholders during the specified period, together with shareholder statements of consistent reporting. The 2020 Form 1120-S material in the record is presented as a generated form based on fictional data, not as proof of filing.
